newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end firm, encouraged by resilient gilts.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end firm, encouraged by resilient gilts.

text.p: Firmer UK shares closed just below the day's best levels, propped up by a firm gilt market as UK interest rates were left unchanged. But traders said the market reamined wary ahead of Friday's jobs report in the U.S.
The FTSE 100 index finished up 14.5 points at 3,887.2 on Thursday. Gainers outweighed losers by roughly five-to-four.
The leading index was buoyed by the steady performance of UK gilts on relief following the UK's decision to leave interest rates unchanged after the monthly monetary meeting.
Some economists had feared that political motives would result in an economically unjustified rate cut.
